description: This file defines a configuration array that maps various Param classes to factory functions. Each factory function creates instances of specific Param classes using dependencies retrieved from a dependency injection container, primarily ValidatorFactory and BeanManager. It also merges this configuration array into a larger custom array using CustomLoader.

classes.name: Param
classes.description: Namespace grouping various parameter classes related to API operations, such as ListViewSearchParams, GetUserPreferencesParams, etc.

methods.name: mergeCustomArray
methods.description: Static method to merge an array of custom configurations into a larger array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Method of the container interface to retrieve services or dependencies by class name.
